topic: Dolphins sleep with half their brain
script: Dolphins sleep with only half of their brain at a time. One half rests while the other stays awake, and often one eye stays open. This lets them keep surfacing to breathe and watch for danger. Bottlenose dolphins use signature whistles that work a lot like names. Dolphins can also recognize themselves in a mirror.
